Description: "Appropriate measures", "means reasonably likely" and "limited to what is necessary" do not state which evidence suffices; organizations fall into paper-only compliance or ad hoc engineering
The DPIA is performed once, becomes outdated with retraining and drift, does not cover AI-specific risks (inferred data, automated decisions) and overlaps with the AI Act FRIA
Erasure, rectification and consent withdrawal are hard once data are in the weights; machine unlearning is not mature
Isolated techniques address one segment of the cycle; there is no guidance on which PET to use for each risk and phase, nor standardized metrics
Missing links between legal requirement, technical control and audit evidence, and no protocol for post-deployment audit
